about_the_game:
The character songs from Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade, all in one collection!
Featuring three original tracks performed by Shigure (voiced by Yoko Hikasa), Sara (voiced by Ayana Taketatsu), and Taketora (voiced by Rikiya Koyama).
Includes both FLAC and MP3 formats. Relive the enchanting Edo-inspired fantasy adventure in stunning high-quality audio!
